title: Lane start loses a pending task record when its claim fails
body: takePendingTask moves the record off refs/krn/pending-tasks into main tasks/ before claimTask; a refused claim (open after dependency) rolls back only worktree and branch, so the pending entry is lost and main is dirty (src/cli/lane.ts start rollback, src/task/pending.ts takePendingTask).

Evidence: an external Gemini audit (2026-11-20) wrote the reproduction .krn/runs/gemini-audit/d6-*.test.ts; it fails by assertion on main 1856e2d, and an independent krn-reader pass confirmed the premise and the expected behaviour against the source.
Outcome: the reproduction becomes the regression test at the lowest layer that shows the defect (KRN-14) and passes; the fix names the defect class in Root cause and Redesign lines (KRN-15).

Files: src/cli/lane.ts, src/task/pending.ts, test/task/pending-records.test.ts
Proof: node --test .krn/runs/gemini-audit/d6-lane-start-loses-pending.test.ts fails by assertion on the base and passes after the fix
